label: Edimax ES-3308P 8-port Fast Ethernet desktop switch
description: Edimax ES-3308P - 8x 10/100 Mbps RJ45 unmanaged desktop switch, store-and-forward, 802.3az Energy Efficient Ethernet with inactive-link and cable-length detection. No PoE, no management interface, no VLANs: plug in and it forwards.
notes: Unmanaged by design: no console, no web interface, no VLANs, so it is one of the few specs here that deliberately declares neither `cli` nor `http-server` - a lab expecting a prompt from it would be wrong. 10/100 only, so a gigabit-only device on a port is refused rather than silently downshifted: auto-negotiation here tops out at 100M. The page carries no port table (it defers to a datasheet), so the eight RJ45 sockets are the ones its own title and description state. Energy Efficient Ethernet, inactive-link detection and cable-length power scaling are power features with no forwarding consequence and are not modelled.
